relationships.evidence_quote: Among monoclonal antibodies targeting the CGRP ligand, galcanezumab is a highly specific and potent humanized antibody [34].

relationships.subject: Galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The MIDAS and HIT-6 scores also documented a significant improvement (p < 0.001).

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic administration of CGRP in migraine patients is sufficient to trigger a migraine-like attack phenotypically similar to the subject’s usual migraine attack [33].

key_findings: Galcanezumab 120 mg monthly significantly reduced headache days, pain intensity, analgesic use and MIDAS/HIT-6 disability in CM and HFEM patients.
Correlation between headache days and MIDAS strengthened during treatment.
